description: Agent with a workflow as a tool: Claude calls a child workflow (HTTP + jq lookup in a 1.4 MB dataset) through a sub_workflow function, once per country, and computes the answer from the results.

config.filter: . as $in | [$in.body[] | select((.name.common | ascii_downcase) == ($in.country | ascii_downcase))] | if length == 0 then {found: false, country: $in.country} else (.[0] | {found: true, name: .name.common, capital: (.capital // [] | first), area_km2: .area, region, subregion}) end

workflow.name: FT10 LLM agent with a workflow tool

config.instruction: You answer with data from the country_facts tool only. Call it once for each country you need. Never use remembered numbers.
config.prompt: Which is larger by area, {{input.a}} or {{input.b}}, and how many times larger (rounded to one decimal place)? Start your answer with the larger country's name, then give the ratio as a number.

functions.name: country_facts
functions.description: Looks up a country in the reference dataset and returns its area in km2, capital and region.

country.description: Common English name of the country
